match: any equation/function to plot on xy axes — "y = x^3 - 2x", "z^4", "sin(x)", a polynomial/trig/exponential curve, a drawn graph or axes with a formula; any single variable letter works
params: {"fn": "<math expression, one variable>" e.g. "x^3 - 2x + 1", "sin(x)", "z^4", "e^x", "sqrt(x)"; "x_min"/"x_max": number — transcribe the formula as written (caret ^ powers, no need for JS syntax); default range -10..10
